gmr.reference_kind: Current Val-best only; other epochs have no retained prediction exports.

oracle_presence.definition: Perfect binary presence decisions; retain every positive query and reject every negative query; localization candidates and ranking stay fixed.
oracle_presence.threshold_interpretation: Horizontal analytical ceiling; not a thresholded 0/1 score curve. At threshold=1 a bounded scored classifier still rejects all queries.
